scenarios.name: Reverse a rotation using the remaining adjacent pairs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid at an inclined orientation in the MCAD Software
the incremental view rotation dialog is open with increment 10
the user clicks direction button 3 once
the user clicks direction button 4 once
the block returns to its initial apparent orientation
the dialog closes and the status area displays Ready
